The dataset currently records this only as an eitza edge (reference 1044, type eitza). A bechina edge must be added: speaking faith = faith (they share the same essential nature — not cause-and-effect but identity).

additions.reason: Wholesomeness/simplicity is the essential quality the Rebbe prescribes as the name for what faith is in divine service: 'לִהְיוֹת תָּם וְיָשָׁר... לַעֲבֹד אוֹתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ בִּתְמִימוּת'. Tam (whole/simple) and emunah (faith) are two names for the same quality of unmediated, received trust in God. This is not eitza (wholesomeness does not produce faith as a separate effect — they ARE the same thing in this Torah).
additions.source_quote: וְזֶה כְּלָל גָּדוֹל וִיסוֹד וְעִקָּר בַּעֲבוֹדַת הַשֵּׁם – לִהְיוֹת תָּם וְיָשָׁר... לַעֲבֹד אוֹתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ בִּתְמִימוּת, בְּלִי שׁוּם חָכְמוֹת וַחֲקִירוֹת

additions.reason: The Rebbe uses פשיטות and תמימות as synonymous in the Torah's climactic sentence: 'לַעֲבֹד אֶת ה' בִּתְמִימוּת בִּפְשִׁיטוּת גָּמוּר'. Plain simplicity and wholesomeness are two names for the same quality — the state of simple, unmediated faith. 'זֶה הִיא הַחָכְמָה הַגְּדוֹלָה שֶׁבְּכָל הַחָכְמוֹת, לִבְלִי לִהְיוֹת חָכָם כְּלָל' — not being wise at all is itself the greatest wisdom. Peshitut is a bechina of tamimut and of emunah.
additions.source_quote: לַעֲבֹד אֶת ה' בִּתְמִימוּת בִּפְשִׁיטוּת גָּמוּר בְּלִי שׁוּם חָכְמוֹת

additions.reason: The Torah concludes with 'רַחֲמָנָא לִבָּא בָּעֵי' — God wants the heart. The Rebbe places this as the ultimate foundation ('הָעִקָּר הוּא') after all the preceding discussion. The heart is the name for what emunah, tamimut, and peshitut all ARE in their innermost essence: sincere inwardness before God, as opposed to external cleverness. Lev is a bechina of emunah and tamimut in this Torah.
additions.source_quote: וְהָעִקָּר הוּא, כִּי רַחֲמָנָא לִבָּא בָּעֵי (סנהדרין קו: זוהר תצא דף רפא:)

additions.reason: Denial/heresy is the direct evil counterpart of emunah (Package 1). The Rebbe describes 'דִּבּוּר הַזֶּה שֶׁל כְּפִירָה' as damaging to emunah. Just as spoken faith IS faith (bechina), spoken kefira IS kefira — the evil equivalent of the same structural identity. Kefira and apikorset are used interchangeably and belong in Package 2.
additions.source_quote: כִּי הַדִּבּוּר הַזֶּה שֶׁל כְּפִירָה מַזִּיק לָאֱמוּנָה

additions.reason: Apostasy/heresy (apikorset) is used synonymously with kefira throughout the Torah. The Rebbe warns against 'דִּבּוּרִים שֶׁל כְּפִירָה וְאֶפִּיקוֹרְסוּת' — the two are a bechina pair within the evil domain. Both name the same corrupting quality: words that deny God and damage faith.
additions.source_quote: לִזָּהֵר מְאֹד מִדִּבּוּרִים שֶׁל כְּפִירָה וְאֶפִּיקוֹרְסוּת

additions.reason: Philosophical inquiry (chakira) is listed alongside philosophy books as equally damaging to faith: 'כִּי הֵם מַזִּיקִים מְאֹד לָאֱמוּנָה'. The Rebbe also warns against chakira-books written by great Jewish scholars, placing them in the same category as non-Jewish philosophy. Chakira shares the essential nature of kefira and apikorset in this Torah: false intellectual wisdom that corrodes faith.
additions.source_quote: וַאֲפִלּוּ מִסְּפָרִים שֶׁל חַקִירָה שֶׁחִבְּרוּ גְּדוֹלִים מֵאַחֵינוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, גַּם מֵהֶם צָרִיךְ לְהַרְחִיק מְאֹד, כִּי הֵם מַזִּיקִים מְאֹד לָאֱמוּנָה

additions.reason: Philosophy (philosophy books/philosophers) is the archetypal example of the corrupting inquiry that damages faith. The Rebbe explicitly groups 'סִפְרֵי הַמְחַקְרִים הַפִילוֹסוֹפְיָא' together with chakira books. Pilsofia names the same domain of corrupting inquiry.
additions.source_quote: לְהַרְחִיק עַצְמוֹ מְאֹד מְאֹד לִבְלִי לְעַיֵּן כְּלָל בְּסִפְרֵי הַמְחַקְרִים הַפִּילוֹסוֹפְיָא

additions.reason: The Rebbe reveals the true nature of the pseudo-wisdoms of divine service: 'הֵם רַק דִּמְיוֹנוֹת וּשְׁטוּתִים וּבִלְבּוּלִים גְּדוֹלִים' — they are only fantasies, foolishnesses, and great confusions. This is a bechina statement: those alleged wisdoms ARE dimyonot and bilbulim — not merely that they lead to confusion, but that confusion and fantasy is their essential nature. These belong in Package 2 as the revealed inner face of chakira/kefira.

analysis_notes.note_on_existing_edge: The single edge in torahData.js for reference 1044 has type 'eitza' (שמדברין האמונה בפה → אמונה). This captures only one dimension of the Rebbe's statement. The sentence 'זֶהוּ בְּעַצְמוֹ אֱמוּנָה' is an identity claim (bechina), not a causal claim. The eitza edge correctly captures 'וְגַם עַל־יְדֵי־זֶה בָּאִים לֶאֱמוּנָה' (through this one also comes to faith). But the first half — 'זֶהוּ בְּעַצְמוֹ אֱמוּנָה' — should be encoded as a bechina edge in addition to the existing eitza edge.
analysis_notes.good_evil_mirror: Package 1 (אמונה/תמימות/לב) and Package 2 (כפירה/אפיקורסות/חקירה) are exact mirrors. The Torah's entire structure is built on this polarity: the same mouth that expresses faith can express heresy; the same capacity for wisdom can be used for tamimut or for dimyonot. This is a classic Rebbe Nachman good/evil mirror — same structural reality, opposite orientation.
analysis_notes.mara_shchora_note: מרה שחורה (melancholy/black bile) and חיות (vitality) appear in paragraph 5 but are connected to the scrupulousness discussion by eitza, not bechina. The scrupulous person lacks chiyut (eitza consequence), not because chiyut IS a bechina of emunah (though that may be implied elsewhere). In this specific Torah text, these are left as eitza concepts rather than added to a bechina package.
